irac.issue: Whether the respondents are entitled to compensation for the acquisition of land under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, and if so, what is the extent of compensation
irac.rule: The provisions of Section 4(1) and Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, regarding the publication of notifications for acquisition of land are mandatory and must be strictly complied with.
irac.application: The Court held that the notification under Section 4(1) and the declaration under Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, were not published in the Official Gazette as required by law. Therefore, the subsequent proceedings for acquisition of land were invalid.
irac.conclusion: The Court set aside the judgments of the High Court and the lower courts and remanded the matter for fresh consideration in accordance with the law.
